description: Preferred runway modes, owner-supplied 24-10-2026, in priority order (order in this file is the tie-break): 1 24A21AD; 2 03AD06D. 24A21AD lands on 24 and 21 and departs from 21. 03AD06D lands on 03 and departs from 03 and 06. The four single-runway modes are NOT from the owner: they were added as the lowest-priority fallback so the planner still has a mode when the preferred two fail; the owner can remove or reorder them. No crosswind limit or capacity has been supplied for any mode; they fall back to the pack default and have no capacity limit.
